string.text: Anastasia
Hello!
Far from home?
You could say that. I don't think I've seen you here before. I'm Anastasia, but you can call me Ana.
Nice to meet you. So, what are you doing in the Zone, Ana?
Right now? Sitting on my ass with whole lot of nothing to do.
Isn't that Freedom armour you're wearing?
Yes, I used to stick around with them before... before we parted ways. Had a few friends in there. Past tense. Some died, god rest their souls, and some left the Zone for good.
Why stay then?

I've got medical background. Look at the guys around. Aside from Sidorovich, Wolf, Fanatic, and that ex-merc I helped in patching up some time back, most of them are callow, green rookies. Besides, I'm sure it's uplifting their spirits if it's a woman's gentle touch they feel when they are getting brought back from the brink.
I sure wouldn't mind if you helped me get back into stalking shape.

Haha, I'm sure you wouldn't. But there's a problem. I ran out of supplies to patch up anyone with wounds more severe than a paper cut. Tell you what - if you get any package with medical supplies during your trips into the wild outside the village, bring it to me. I'll put it to good use, be it on you or anyone else bleeding to death.
I'll see what I can do.
Thank you. You know where to find me.
I've got something for you.
Found anything for me?
A package of basic medical supplies.
Ah, thank you, it will more than suffice. I'll be able to patch you up now any time you come back. Just make sure to come back alive - I'm not good enough to resurrect the dead.
A package of military medical supplies.
That's amazing! Thank you so much! With this, I'll be able to patch up anyone unlucky to have a close call, including you. Please, take this as a token of my gratitude. And again, thank you.
A package of medical supplies the scientists use.

You're a real hotshot, you know that? All that medicine... Thank you so much! I won't be able to ever repay you properly, but please, take it. You've more than earned it with all the lives you've helped me save with this.
Nevermind.
Could you patch me up, Ana?
Of course. Please, hold still. It might sting...
Do you have any spare supplies I could take for the road?
Please, have a look.
Could you help me with my gear?
Sure thing.
Do you need any more help?

Hmm.. Yes, I could use your help with one other thing. There's no mechanic here in the Rookie Village. Now, I may be coming from a med school, but I didn't survive here in the Zone on looks and kind word alone. I know the basics of how to work a gun.
In other words, you want me to bring you some tools?

Bingo. Just the basic kind, though, there's simply no proper environment here for more than some basic maintenance, and I'm not remotely good enough to provide any kind of help with modification. Still, even just that should be more than enough. Can I count on you again?
I'll see what I can do.
Great! Then you know where to find me.
I've got some tools for you.
Ah, thanks a ton. Here, take this. It's not much, but you've really helped make a difference.
Do you need any more help, Ana?
I've got everything I need, thank you. You're always a welcome sight to me.
Sidorovich, I need a hand with some matter.
Really?
Really. I'd like to help Ana get medical supplies to treat any injured rookies and I hoped you'd contribute to the effort.

Aren't that nice of you. Well, you're in luck. My last runner had an... unfortunate accident with local wildlife and is no longer around to deliver a package for me. Tell you what, kid. I've got here two Doppler weather radar kits that need to find their way to Cold - he's the one calling the shots around Great Swamps. I'll make an arrangement for him to get you the supplies, but you're going to be the one running the lap. How does that sound?
Like a favour for a favour.
Damn straight. Here are the devices, don't lose them along the way. Now get going. I have to contact Cold.
Cold? I've got a package from Sidorovich addressed to you.

Ah, finally, thank you. I'll take them to Novikov later. Here, your reward as promised. Sit down and have a drink with the boys before your trip back if you want. Now, if you'll excuse me, if there's nothing else you'd like to bring up, I'm going to get back to work.
